none: PAS NLM-76D012: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-336, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust possibly left. Obverse inscription: [--]ANT[---]. Reverse description: possibly two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: possibly [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 16.6mm, Weight: 1.78gms, die axis: possibly 6
